root_cause.text: In the RDMA/siw driver, an early error return from `siw_get_hdr()` in `siw_tcp_rx_data()` bypasses the execution of `set_rx_fpdu_context()`, leaving `qp->rx_fpdu` uninitialized (NULL) when the error handling path subsequently attempts to dereference it to check `more_ddp_segs`.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "If siw_get_hdr() returns -EINVAL before set_rx_fpdu_context(), qp->rx_fpdu can be NULL. The error path in siw_tcp_rx_data() dereferences qp->rx_fpdu->more_ddp_segs without checking". This is supported by the patch diff in `siw_qp_rx.c`, which adds a NULL check for `qp->rx_fpdu` before accessing `qp->rx_fpdu->more_ddp_segs`: `(qp->rx_fpdu && qp->rx_fpdu->more_ddp_segs)`.
